theorem_I.semigroup: Products of nonempty words only; no automatically adjoined empty-word identity.
theorem_I.forgetting: Some N makes every generator word of length at least N rectangular.
theorem_I.ideal: I=S intersect Rect, where the empty relation is rectangular; I may be empty or all S.
proof: Relational multiplication on either side preserves rectangularity.
A generated nonrectangular idempotent pumps through arbitrarily long admitted words.
Finite Ramsey on interval products supplies an idempotent contiguous factor in every sufficiently long word.
A rectangular factor forces the entire product rectangular.

rees_quotient.nonempty_proper_I: All idempotents lie in I iff S/I has no nonzero idempotent iff S/I is nilpotent.
rees_quotient.I_equals_S: Trivial immediate forgetting; quotient is the one-element zero semigroup.
rees_quotient.I_empty: Ordinary nonempty-ideal quotient unavailable; for nonempty finite S both forgetting and all-idempotents condition fail. Adjoining zero gives a uniform reformulation.

theorem_I.empty_word_control: For G={X x X}, |X|>1, positive words forget immediately, but an artificially adjoined identity is a nonrectangular idempotent.

core_result.equivalence: E nonrectangular iff C modulo mutual reachability has at least two classes.
core_result.reason: Every pair of a finite idempotent relation factors through a core point; zero/one class gives an empty/rectangular relation.

correct_conserved_label_test.definition: Nonconstant values on active endpoint supports satisfying f(x)=g(y) for every xEy.
correct_conserved_label_test.criterion: At least two connected components in the classical bipartite incidence graph on dom(E) and im(E).
correct_conserved_label_test.core_comparability: A connected undirected core comparability graph suffices for absence of a global label; one comparable pair does not.
correct_conserved_label_test.restricted_case: If reflexive on active support, incidence components agree with weak components of the core preorder.
correct_conserved_label_test.warning: Core labels may fail to extend globally through transient endpoints.

counterexamples.purpose: Antichain core classes need not preserve any endpoint label.
counterexamples.hand_check: Each nonempty row repeats itself through its loop; all active starts share output 001, forcing their labels equal.

counterexamples.purpose: Comparable core classes can coexist with a conserved parity and no coordinate tie.
counterexamples.relation: Delta_X union (P0 x Q0) union (P1 x Q1)
counterexamples.core: All eight states, each its own equivalence class.
counterexamples.conserved_label: x1 xor x2, coordinates read left to right
counterexamples.hand_check: No two nonidentity transitions compose; parity is constant within each Pi union Qi; diagonal rejects opposite ties and complementary Qi outputs reject equality ties.

counterexamples.purpose: A complement-closed self-tie need not obstruct forgetting when its powers become empty.
counterexamples.direct_power: R^2=empty because dom(R) and im(R) are disjoint.

tie_lemma_repair.required_power_condition: Every power of the tied relation is nonempty; for a finite relation this is equivalent to containing a directed cycle.
tie_lemma_repair.uniform_sufficient_hypothesis: A common nonempty G_S on which every generator has a successor in G_S from every state in G_S.
tie_lemma_repair.proof: Every word is serial on G_S. Its nonempty powers inherit complement closure and the self-tie, giving a full equality/inequality projection and excluding rectangularity.
tie_lemma_repair.parent_report: Earlier permitted referee work supplies the living-set argument; parent is freshly checking it on actual generators.
